text:
incident-bot: PAGE: P99 latency alert for /v1/chat/stream in us-west-2 — SLO p99 > 3s (observed 3.12s). Runbook: streaming-latency.

alex: oncall pinged, looking. seeing preproc CPU up and tokenizer durations spiking.

maria: customers: ~9% of streaming sessions in us-west-2 had visible tail delays, support tickets starting to surface.

sam: Any deploys in the window?

deploy-bot: Deploy 2026-03-14T08:03:12Z: service=preproc-service commit=af3c9de -> prod/us-west-2 (canary=12%).

alex: matches timing. canary introduced change to template engine and json_mode validator.

jin: Metrics: p95 130ms -> 580ms, p99 430ms -> 3120ms. Tail stalls cluster on requests using long tool schemas + json_mode parsing.

caroline: I reproduced locally with heavy tool schemas. tokenizer.tokenize and schema.validate spans are the culprits for the tail stalls.

alex: Traces: attaching top spans (APM link: https://apm.internal/redwood/traces/abc123).

Code (quick view):
```
preproc.tokenizer.tokenize  p99 340ms
preproc.schema.validate     p99 460ms
preproc.template.render     p99 200ms
streaming.send_tail         p99 1200ms
```

maria: Customer impact notes: interactive UIs see delayed final tokens; some clients retry on perceived failure which causes duplicates.

alex: Quick mitigations proposed:
- rollback canary to previous commit
- flip feature flag json_mode off `ff toggle preproc.json_mode --off` (no deploy)
- route heavy streaming traffic to fallback model variant via runtime routing policy
- apply temporary rate limit on prompts with large tool schemas

sam: Which is fastest/least risky? rollback or flag toggle?

alex: Flag toggle is near-instant and reversible, rollback takes ~20m. plan: toggle flag, monitor, then rollback if needed.

oncall-bot: @oncall_user assigned as incident lead. Handoff timer started.

caroline: I'll stage a routing override to send 10% of streaming sessions to fallback variant and prep the FF change.

jin: Also add a temporary tracing sampling rule to 1% to reduce APM noise while we investigate.

maria: I'll notify CS + list impacted customers: acct-42, acct-77, sandbox-team. Drafting a short status blurb.

alex: Doing ff toggle now...

deploy-bot: Feature flag change 2026-03-14T08:15:02Z: preproc.json_mode=off by alex.

alex: Monitoring... p99 dropped from 3.12s -> 1.8s within ~2 minutes. customer impact down to ~1.5%.

maria: Nice. Keep an eye for regressions. We'll prepare a postmortem.

alex: Immediate follow-ups: revert/adjust template change in next patch, add schema validation timeouts (per-request), add unit tests for very large tool schemas, add a preproc circuit-breaker for json_mode.

oncall-bot: Handoff to @oncall_user complete. Incident status: mitigated. Owner: alex. Follow-up: postmortem + timeline doc.

alex: Adding action list to #incidents-postmortems and will sync with SRE and preproc team for remediation schedule.
